newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Campbell Soup raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Campbell Soup raised.

text.p: -- SBC Warburg analyst Chris Jakubik said on Friday he upgraded Campbell Soup Co to add from hold, and also raised his fiscal 1997 estimate to $3.60 a share from $3.50.
-- He also raised his long-term earnings per share growth expectations to 15 percent from 13 percent. The 12-month stock price target was raised to $77 a share from about $65, he added.
-- This followed Campbell's announcement of a share repurchase program and a restructuring plan, which includes a "clear strategic intent" for the food company, Jakubik said.
-- Campbell shares were up 1-1/4 to 72-7/8 in late morning exchange trading.
